headline: Conditioned models steer antibody, molecule and peptide design toward structural targets
label: Conditioned Generative Biomolecular Design
summary: Structure-conditioned generative and predictive models now span antibody CDR design, PROTAC design, and ligand binding-site prediction.
synthesis: The common thread is conditioning models on structural, target, or property information to steer generation or prediction. AbRefine combines backbone-conditioned structural predictions with framework-conditioned antibody language model distributions for CDR design, while pocket contrastive learning with reference-conformation fusion yields 3D molecules robust to receptor conformational variation. DesignMaster applies an E(3)-equivariant diffusion framework conditioned on linker length for PROTAC design, and PolyTamGen generates multitarget ligands from ESM3 target encodings. New in this set is explicit multi-constraint steering: M-GoRT uses goal-conditioned return blocks for multi-objective de novo generation, and DeepSAP pairs conditional generation with property prediction for self-assembling peptides. The thread is not uniform; FunFOLD5, Seq2Pocket and RCP-DTA are predictive rather than generative, and SIMORGH targets apo-state and cryptic binding site prediction.
